title.value: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
title.provenance: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

pfas_definition.value: a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom
pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS substances means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: no person this state shall sell or offer for sale in containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances at or above a level that the department shall establish

date.provenance: no person shall sell or offer for sale in containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances at or above a level that the department shall establish

exceptions: if they can show that they relied in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer of such product that such product met the requirements of this section
